# Control Narrative: Kiln K-100 Heat-Up and Start-Up

This draft turns the senior operator's notes into a testable narrative section. The notes leave out several things that the automation needs, and I have filled those gaps with proposed values marked **confirm**. The most important gaps to close while the senior operator is still available:

1. **"ID fan 60%"** does not say what it is a percentage of: VFD speed, damper position, or design flow. I assumed VFD speed.
2. **"CO at the inlet analyzer, kill the ESP"** is a safety function. It belongs in the SIS (IEC 61511) or the ESP protection system, not only in operator practice. A kiln-inlet analyzer is also usually the wrong location for ESP protection. ESP protection normally uses an analyzer at the preheater exit or ESP inlet.
3. **Calciner firing, the cooler, and the coal mill** are not in the notes. I proposed a calciner light-off point and list the rest as open items.
4. **The rotation schedule** ("every so often, more often as it gets hotter") needs fixed intervals and temperature bands. I proposed a schedule for the senior operator to correct.
5. **All tags are provisional.** Replace them with tags from the instrument index.

---

## 1. Purpose and Boundaries

| ID | Requirement | Test method |
|---|---|---|
| FR-KLN-001 | The K-100 heat-up/start-up module controls the kiln from Cold Idle (S0) to the hand-off to Normal Operation (S6). | FAT: run S0→S6 on the process simulator. |
| FR-KLN-002 | The module controls these items: the main burner B-101 fuel demand, the ID fan F-101 speed limits, the kiln drives M-101 and M-102, the kiln feed FIC-K101, and the ESP energize permissive. | FAT: confirm that each output moves only under this module in S0–S5. |

**Boundaries:**
- **Upstream:** raw meal feed system (bin, extraction, FIC-K101), coal firing system (coal mill, dosing), and diesel supply.
- **Downstream:** clinker cooler, conditioning tower, ESP E-101, and the stack.
- **Separate documents (out of scope):**
  - Burner Management System (BMS). It owns purge, trial-for-ignition, flame supervision, and fuel trips.
  - SIS SRS. It owns the ESP CO trip.
  - Normal Operation narrative (S6).
  - Controlled Cool-Down narrative (S9).
  - Cooler narrative.

## 4. States and Transitions (ISA-106)

| State | Description | Entry permissives | Allowed exits | Initiator | Automation level |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| S0 Cold Idle | No flame. No feed. Kiln stopped or rotating per cool-down. | None | S1 | Operator (START HEAT-UP) | Operator-prompted |
| S1 Purge | BMS purges the kiln system. | F-101 running at or above SP-09. BMS ready. M-102 available. G-101 available. Cooler module "ready for heat-up". Area walk-down confirmed. | S2 (flame proven); S0 (purge fail or operator abort) | Auto after operator start | Automatic (BMS) |
| S2 Heat-Up Diesel | B-101 fires diesel. Back-end ramps at SP-02. Intermittent rotation. | Diesel flame proven | S3; S7; S8; S9 | Operator confirms the S3 prompt | Automatic ramp; operator-prompted changeover |
| S3 Heat-Up Coal | B-101 fires coal. Ramp continues. Rotation per bands, then transfer to main drive. | TY-K101 at or above SP-04. Coal flame proven. Diesel off. | S4; S7; S8; S9 | Auto | Automatic ramp; operator-prompted drive transfer |
| S4 Hot Hold / Ready for Feed | TIC-K101 holds SP-37. M-101 runs. | TY-K101 inside SP-05…SP-06. Tower hot (SP-35, SP-36). M-101 running at or above SP-30. | S5; S7; S8; S9 | Operator (START FEED) | Operator-prompted |
| S5 Feed Ramp | Feed ramps from SP-07. Calciner lights off at SP-42. | All S4 permissives. E-101 energized (OI-06). | S6 (feed at SP-08a); S4 (feed stop); S7; S8 | Auto | Automatic, with operator HOLD |
| S6 Normal Operation | Out of scope. See Normal Operation narrative. | Feed at SP-08a. Calciner flame proven. | Per that narrative | Auto | Per that narrative |
| S7 Fuel Tripped (Hot) | BMS has tripped all fuel. Kiln rotation continues per bands. | Any BMS trip | S1 (operator reset, re-purge); S9; S8 | BMS / operator | Automatic rotation; operator reset |
| S8 Power-Loss Rotation | Main power lost while kiln hot. M-102 turns the kiln on G-101 power. | Loss of main power with TY-K101 above SP-31 | S7 (main power restored) | Auto | Automatic |
| S9 Controlled Cool-Down | Out of scope. See Cool-Down narrative. | Operator command | S0 | Operator | Per that narrative |

| ID | Requirement | Test method |
|---|---|---|
| FR-KLN-010 | The BPCS allows only the transitions in the state table. | FAT: try every non-listed transition and confirm rejection with a message. |
| FR-KLN-011 | An operator HOLD in S2–S5 freezes the TIC-K101 and FIC-K101 ramps, keeps the present fuel and feed, and keeps the rotation sequence running. | FAT: apply HOLD in each state and confirm. |
| FR-KLN-012 | An operator RESUME starts each ramp again from the present PV, with no step change in output. | FAT: confirm a bumpless resume. |
| FR-KLN-013 | The HMI shows the present state, the next state, and each unmet permissive by name. | FAT: force each permissive false and confirm the display. |

## 5. Regulatory Control

| Loop | PV | Output | Action | Mode behavior | Cascade / limits |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| TIC-K101 back-end temperature | TY-K101 | SP to FIC-B101 (S2) or FIC-B102 (S3–S5) | Reverse | Cascade in S2–S4. In S4 the setpoint goes to SP-37. In S5 the loop goes to Manual and fuel follows the operator. Normal Operation takes over in S6. | Ramp generator moves the SP at SP-02. The ramp holds when the measured rate over SP-03 exceeds SP-01. The output clamps at SP-11 while diesel is the fuel. |
| FIC-B101 diesel flow | Diesel flow | Diesel control valve | Direct flow loop | Auto at SP-10 on light-off, then cascade | High limit SP-11 |
| FIC-B102 coal flow | Coal mass flow | Coal dosing rotor speed | Direct flow loop | Auto at SP-12 on light-off, then cascade | Limits per coal system narrative |
| SIC-F101 ID fan speed | F-101 speed | VFD speed reference | Direct | Manual during S1–S5 | Low clamp at SP-09 while any flame is proven. The operator cannot enter a lower value. |
| SIC-K100 kiln speed | Kiln speed | M-101 VFD | Direct | Manual | Low clamp at SP-30 when M-101 runs |
| FIC-K101 kiln feed | Feed flow | Feed extraction | Direct flow loop | Auto. SP ramp from SP-07 to SP-08a over SP-08. | The ramp holds (see FR-KLN-034) |

| ID | Requirement | Test method |
|---|---|---|
| FR-KLN-020 | TIC-K101 ramps the back-end setpoint at SP-02 and holds the ramp when the measured rate exceeds SP-01. | FAT: simulate a fast rise and confirm the ramp holds; on the rate alarm, confirm the alarm. |
| FR-KLN-021 | SIC-F101 does not go below SP-09 while any flame is proven. | FAT: enter a value below SP-09 with flame proven and confirm rejection. |
| FR-KLN-022 | FIC-B101 output does not go above SP-11. | FAT: drive TIC-K101 output high and confirm the clamp. |

## 6. Sequences

**SEQ-A: Heat-up start (S0 → S2).** FR-KLN-030: Execute SEQ-A. Test: FAT simulation of each step and each failure response.

| Step | Action | Transition condition | Timeout | Failure response |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| A1 | Check the S1 entry permissives. | All permissives true | T-01 | Stay in S0. Show the unmet permissives. |
| A2 | Prompt: "Walk down kiln K-100. Confirm area clear." | Operator confirms | T-01 | Cancel. Return to S0. |
| A3 | Request BMS purge. | BMS purge complete | T-02 | Return to S0. Alarm PURGE FAIL. |
| A4 | Prompt "LIGHT DIESEL". Request BMS light-off with FIC-B101 at SP-10. | B-101 diesel flame proven | T-03 | BMS handles the trip. Go to S1 for re-purge. Alarm LIGHT-OFF FAIL. |
| A5 | Set TIC-K101 SP equal to TY-K101. Start ramp at SP-02. Put TIC-K101 in cascade. | TIC-K101 in cascade | T-01 | Hold. Alarm. Operator puts FIC-B101 in Manual. |
| A6 | Start SEQ-R. Enter S2. | SEQ-R running | T-01 | Hold ramp. Alarm ROTATION NOT RUNNING. |

**SEQ-R: Heat-up rotation (runs in S2, S3, S7 until M-101 runs).** FR-KLN-031: Execute SEQ-R. Test: FAT, simulate TY-K101 in each band and time the rotations.

**WARNING:** Sound XA-K100 before each rotation. Personnel near the kiln can get caught in moving parts.

| Step | Action | Transition condition | Timeout | Failure response |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| R1 | Select the interval from TY-K101: band 1 SP-21, band 2 SP-23, band 3 SP-25, band 4 SP-27. Above SP-26, go to R5. | Interval timer expired | Interval + SP-32 | Alarm ROTATION OVERDUE |
| R2 | Sound XA-K100 for SP-34. | Horn complete | SP-34 | Continue to R3 |
| R3 | Start M-102. | ST-K100 counts SP-28 | T-04 | Stop M-102. Alarm ROTATION FAIL. Hold TIC-K101 ramp. Prompt operator to turn kiln locally. |
| R4 | Stop M-102. Reset interval timer. Go to R1. | M-102 stopped | T-04 | Alarm M-102 FAIL TO STOP |
| R5 | Run M-102 continuously. | M-101 running (SEQ-M complete) | None (continuous) | If M-102 stops: alarm KILN STOPPED HOT. Restart attempt per R3. |

**SEQ-C: Diesel to coal changeover (S2 → S3).** FR-KLN-032: Execute SEQ-C. Test: FAT simulation, including coal flame failure at C2.

| Step | Action | Transition condition | Timeout | Failure response |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| C1 | When TY-K101 reaches SP-04, hold the TIC-K101 ramp. Prompt "CHANGE TO COAL". | Coal system ready and operator confirms | T-01 | Ramp stays held. Diesel continues. Repeat the prompt. |
| C2 | Request BMS coal light-off. Set FIC-B102 to SP-12. | Coal flame proven | T-05 | Stop coal through BMS. Stay on diesel. Alarm COAL LIGHT-OFF FAIL. |
| C3 | Move the TIC-K101 output from diesel to coal on a total-heat basis (OI-08). | FIC-B101 at SP-10 | T-06 | Hold the present split. Alarm. Operator completes in Manual. |
| C4 | Request BMS diesel stop. | Diesel valves closed | T-03 | Alarm DIESEL NOT CLOSED. BMS action. |
| C5 | Release the TIC-K101 ramp. Enter S3. | Ramp running | T-01 | Hold. Alarm. |

**SEQ-M: Transfer to main drive (inside S3).** FR-KLN-033: Execute SEQ-M. Test: FAT simulation, including M-101 start failure.

| Step | Action | Transition condition | Timeout | Failure response |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| M1 | When TY-K101 reaches SP-29, prompt "TRANSFER TO MAIN DRIVE". | Operator confirms | T-01 | M-102 continues. Repeat the prompt. |
| M2 | Stop M-102. Disengage the clutch. | ZS-K102 disengaged | T-07 | Re-engage. Restart M-102. Alarm CLUTCH FAIL. |
| M3 | Sound XA-K100. Start M-101 at SP-30. | SIC-K100 PV at SP-30 | T-08 | Stop M-101. Re-engage clutch. Restart M-102. Alarm MAIN DRIVE START FAIL. |
| M4 | Stop SEQ-R. | SEQ-R stopped | T-01 | Alarm |

The total standstill in M2–M3 must stay below SP-33 (FR-KLN-041 applies).

**SEQ-F: Feed introduction and ramp (S4 → S5 → S6).** FR-KLN-034: Execute SEQ-F. The FIC-K101 ramp holds when TY-K101 is below SP-41, TI-K110 is above SP-39, AT-K101 CO is above SP-13, or the operator selects HOLD. Test: FAT, force each hold cause.

| Step | Action | Transition condition | Timeout | Failure response |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| F1 | Check S5 entry permissives. | All true | T-01 | Stay in S4. Show unmet permissives. |
| F2 | Prompt "START FEED". | Operator confirms | T-01 | Stay in S4. TIC-K101 holds SP-37. |
| F3 | Start feed at SP-07. Put TIC-K101 in Manual. Enter S5. | FIC-K101 PV within D-01 of SP | T-09 | Stop feed. Return to S4. Alarm FEED START FAIL. |
| F4 | Ramp FIC-K101 SP toward SP-08a over SP-08. Hold at SP-42 until F5 completes. | FIC-K101 SP at SP-42 | SP-08 + T-10 | Hold ramp. Alarm FEED RAMP STALLED. |
| F5 | When TT-T101 is above SP-43, prompt "LIGHT CALCINER". Request BMS light-off of B-102. | Calciner flame proven | T-03 | Ramp stays at SP-42. Alarm CALCINER LIGHT-OFF FAIL. |
| F6 | Continue ramp to SP-08a. | FIC-K101 PV at SP-08a | SP-08 + T-10 | Hold ramp. Alarm. |
| F7 | Hand off to Normal Operation. Enter S6. | Normal Operation module active | T-01 | Stay in S5. Alarm. |

## 7. Interlocks and Permissives (no C&E chart given)

| Cause | Effect | Latched / auto-reset | Reset method | Owner |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| F-101 stopped or run feedback lost while flame proven | Trip all fuel (B-101, B-102). Go to S7. | Latched | BMS reset after re-purge | BMS |
| AT-E101 CO above SP-16 | De-energize all E-101 T/R sets | Latched | CO below SP-17 for SP-18, then operator reset at E-101 panel | **SIS. SRS to specify (OI-02)**. BPCS shows status only. |
| AT-E101 analyzer fault | De-energize E-101 (fail-safe) | Latched | Analyzer healthy, CO below SP-17 for SP-18, operator reset | SIS (OI-02) |
| AT-E101 CO above SP-17, or clear time not met | Block E-101 energize | Auto-reset | Auto | BPCS permissive |
| TY-K101 rate above SP-01 | Hold TIC-K101 ramp | Auto-reset | Rate below SP-01 | BPCS |
| TY-K101 at SP-04 in S2 | Hold TIC-K101 ramp until SEQ-C completes | Auto-reset | SEQ-C step C5 | BPCS |
| M-101 trip in S4/S5 | Stop feed FIC-K101. Go to S4 (S5) or stay S4. Start SEQ-R step R3 on M-102. | Latched | Operator restarts M-101 by SEQ-M | BPCS |
| Main power loss with TY-K101 above SP-31 | Start M-102 on G-101 power within SP-33. Go to S8. | Latched | Operator, after main power returns | BPCS + MCC hardwired (OI-04) |
| Feed system trip | Go to S4. TIC-K101 to cascade at SP-37. | Latched | Operator START FEED | BPCS |
| M-101 running | Block M-102 start (clutch interlock) | Auto-reset | M-101 stopped | MCC hardwired |
| ZS-K102 engaged | Block M-101 start | Auto-reset | Clutch disengaged | MCC hardwired |

FR-KLN-040: The BPCS implements the BPCS rows above. Test: FAT, force each cause and confirm the effect and reset.
FR-KLN-041: M-102 runs within SP-33 of loss of main power when TY-K101 is above SP-31. Test: SAT, open the main incomer with G-101 in auto. Time M-102 start.

## 8. Alarms (no rationalized database given; priorities are provisional for ISA-18.2 rationalization)

| Alarm | Condition | Priority | Operator response |
|---|---|---|---|
| HEAT-UP RATE HIGH | TY-K101 rate above SP-01 | High | Make sure the ramp holds. Decrease fuel if the rate does not fall. |
| ROTATION OVERDUE | R1 timer above interval + SP-32 | High | Turn the kiln with M-102 locally. |
| ROTATION FAIL | R3 timeout | High | Find the cause. Turn the kiln locally. |
| KILN STOPPED HOT | Kiln speed zero and TY-K101 above SP-31 | Critical | Start M-102. Call the shift supervisor. |
| KILN-INLET CO HIGH | AT-K101 CO above SP-13 | High | Increase SIC-F101. Decrease fuel. |
| KILN-INLET O2 LOW | AT-K102 below SP-14 | High | Increase SIC-F101. Decrease fuel. |
| ESP-INLET CO HIGH | AT-E101 above SP-15 | Critical | Decrease fuel. Increase SIC-F101. Prepare for E-101 trip. |
| ESP CO TRIP | SIS trip active | Critical | Stabilize combustion. Reset only per the SRS. |
| SHELL TEMP HIGH | TI-K110 above SP-38 | High | Find the zone. Make sure the kiln rotates. Tell the supervisor. |
| SHELL TEMP HIGH-HIGH | TI-K110 above SP-39 | Critical | Decrease fuel. Hold the feed ramp. Start the hot-spot procedure (OI-09). |
| BACK-END TEMP HIGH | TY-K101 above SP-40 | High | Decrease fuel. |
| BACK-END TC DEVIATION | TT-K101A/B differ by more than SP-44 | Medium | Request instrument check. |
| ID FAN AT MINIMUM | SIC-F101 at SP-09 clamp | Low | Information only. |
| Sequence failures | Each failure in Section 6 | High | Per the step failure response. |

## 9. Abnormal Handling

| Condition | Detection | Response | Fail position |
|---|---|---|---|
| TT-K101A or B bad | Out of range or failed | TY-K101 uses the healthy element. Alarm. | — |
| Both TT-K101 bad | Both out of range | Hold TIC-K101 ramp. TIC-K101 to Manual at last output. SEQ-R uses the last good band. Alarm. | Last output |
| AT-K101/K102 bad or in blowback | Analyzer status | Hold heat-up and feed ramps. Alarm after blowback time (OI-03). | — |
| AT-E101 bad | Analyzer status | SIS action per SRS. BPCS blocks E-101 energize. | E-101 de-energized |
| TI-K110 scanner fault | Scanner status | Hold feed ramp. Alarm. | — |
| ST-K100 bad | No pulses with drive running | Rotation by time on M-102 (OI-05). Alarm. | — |
| BPCS–HMI comms loss | Watchdog | Controller continues the present step. Prompted steps wait. Ramps hold. | Last state |
| BPCS–MCC comms loss | Watchdog | M-101 continues at last speed. M-102 power-loss start stays hardwired. | Drive: last speed |
| Loss of main power | Incomer status | S8. BMS trips fuel. M-102 on G-101. | Fuel valves closed. Feed gate closed. E-101 de-energized. F-101 stops. |
| Power restore | Incomer status | Go to S7. No automatic restart of fuel, feed, or F-101. Operator restarts from SEQ-A step A1. | — |
| Controller restart | Controller restart flag | Outputs to fail positions. Sequences go to Hold. Operator confirms the state before resume. | Per above |

FR-KLN-050: The module behaves as the table above. Test: FAT, simulate each condition.
FR-KLN-051: After a power or controller restart, the module does not start fuel, feed, or F-101 without an operator command. Test: FAT, restart the controller in S2–S5.

## 10. Operator Interface

FR-KLN-060: The kiln start-up display shows these items:
- The present state.
- TY-K101 against the target heat-up curve.
- The measured heat-up rate.
- The rotation countdown and the active band.
- The M-101/M-102 status.
- The ID fan clamp status.
- AT-K101, AT-K102, and AT-E101.
- The TI-K110 profile.
- The feed ramp progress.

Test: FAT display walk-through with operations.

FR-KLN-061: The operator can change SP-02 only within the limit of SP-01. Test: FAT, enter a value above SP-01 and confirm rejection.

FR-KLN-062: Operations signs off all states and prompts in Sections 4 and 6 before FAT. Test: signed review record.

**Prompts:** "Walk down kiln K-100. Confirm area clear." / "LIGHT DIESEL" / "CHANGE TO COAL" / "TRANSFER TO MAIN DRIVE" / "START FEED" / "LIGHT CALCINER".
